item.title: Bunnie Xo Reacts to Jelly Roll’s Daughter Claiming Internet Would ‘Crumble’ If Full Truth of Their Divorce Came Out
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest update on the music scene. We're talking about the recent divorce of country star Jelly Roll and his ex-wife, Bunnie Xo. Their 18-year-old daughter, Bailee Ann, made some comments that left fans confused, suggesting there's more to the story than we know.
[Short music transition]
Host: Bailee went live on TikTok, saying that if the full truth behind her dad and stepmom's split was revealed, the internet would "crumble". But when a fan asked Bunnie to address the comments, she responded with a simple "Nothing to clear up". Bunnie explained that Bailee didn't say anything out of the ordinary, and that people are just running with a narrative.
[Short music transition]
Host: Bunnie has been open about the reasons behind their divorce, citing a breakdown in communication due to Jelly Roll's high-profile life. She even shared that she dared him to file divorce papers during a fight on Mother's Day, but didn't expect him to actually do it.
[Short music transition]
Host: Despite the split, Bunnie and Jelly are on good terms and have chosen to continue their IVF journey together as coparents. But Bailee's comments had fans wondering if there was more to the story. Bailee later clarified that her livestream wasn't meant to promote her own future podcast, and that she stands by what she said.
[Short music transition]
Host: Jelly Roll hasn't spoken much about the divorce, except for a few comments on stage during his recent tour. The divorce was finalized in July, with Jelly Roll set to give Bunnie a one-time lump-sum payment. That's the latest update on this story. Thanks for tuning in!
[Outro music plays]
